Connector and battery-pack models of the complete X1 excavator

Each model drawn from its maker's drawing (track_wheel_jgy370/X1/source/stdparts.py); drag to turn, wheel to zoom. The same models sit in their places in 3D_preview.html and in step/connectors/*.step. Types, mates, contacts and locations: CONNECTORS.md.

The board-side headers (top entry: B2B/B4B-XH-A, B3B/B4B-PH-K-S) are drawn here from the JST catalogue; on the board itself the viewer uses KiCad's own models from the board STEP. The MINI FHM holder's body is an envelope from photographs.
